Team —

Darius Okoye confirmed Wed 8/25 at 1pm PT for a 60-min technical screen. Quick coordination notes and asks:

1) Ben — would you take the coding block (first 30m) on CoderPad? I’ll send the invite and session link. Candidate prefers PT; please account for your EST schedule.
2) Kimberly — would you cover the ML system design / inference discussion (last 30m)? Focus on inference tradeoffs for quantized models and caching strategies; we want to see system-level reasoning and practical trade-offs.
3) Soojin — can you create the CoderPad session and add the standard test harness (our template uses two warmup tests and 3 hidden tests)? If you don’t have time, ping Jasmine and I can patch in the template.

Attachments I’ll include in the interview packet: ri-technical-specs.md (short checklist), coderpad-invite.link (session ID), screening-calendar.ics.

Please reply with availability for a quick 10-minute pre-brief 30 minutes before the session (12:30 PT / 3:30 ET) so we can align on rubric and question flow.
